# About the Person
Srdjan Marinkovic is a web professional based in Serbia with a unique background - transitioning from criminal law to web development in 2017. He currently holds dual leadership positions at Elementor:

1. ATS Team Lead - Leading a CX team of ~15 experts and developers
2. Serbia Site Manager - Overseeing operations, HR, events, and culture for ~35 team members
